name: Philips Hue Wall Switch Module (EU)

radios.note: Zigbee 3.0 per CSA; Hue's page also lists Bluetooth.

matter.note: CSA lists the module as Zigbee 3.0 only. Hue says Matter reaches it only via the Hue Bridge, which has its own Matter certificate.

apple_home.note: Hue's product page lists Apple HomeKit for this module, through the Hue Bridge.

google_home.note: Hue lists Google Home and says Matter support is via the Bridge only.

alexa.note: Hue lists Alexa; the Bridge is the link.

smartthings.note: Hue's page lists Samsung SmartThings among third-party systems.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Hue integration, through the Bridge, exposes Hue remotes and switches as device triggers and battery sensors; the docs don't name this module.

hubRequired.note: Hue's product page says a Hue Bridge is needed to control Hue lights with the module; without it, lights can't be controlled.

localControl.note: Not stated in the sources found.

switchForm.note: 43 x 38 x 10 mm module connected to the free contacts of an existing wall switch.

dimmer.note: It does not switch a load; it sends commands to Hue lights, which do the dimming. It does not work with switches that have built-in dimmers.

neutralRequired.note: Battery powered (CR2450, at least 5 years), no wiring to mains. The separate wired module needs neutral.

gangs.note: Number of switch inputs per module not confirmed in the sources found.

summary: Battery-powered and wired to no mains, the Philips Hue Wall Switch Module connects to the free contacts of an existing wall switch (43 x 38 x 10 mm) and turns it into a Hue control. It does not dim or switch the load itself; it sends commands to Hue lights. Everything goes through a Hue Bridge, which covers Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant, and Matter reaches it only via the Bridge. A CR2450 cell is rated at five years or more.
caveats: Needs a Hue Bridge; without one it cannot control Hue lights.
It only sends commands to Hue lights and does not switch a load.
Does not work with switches that have built-in dimmers.
There is also a wired Hue wall switch module that needs a neutral wire; this record covers the battery one.
